question: Who are the seven world-lords presiding from the earth world upward?
premises: The verse names Sharva, Rudra, Bhima, Bhava, Ugra, Mahan, and Ishana.
These seven are described as lords of the worlds.
They preside from the earth world upward as forms of Shiva.
inference: The cosmic hierarchy is governed by seven Shiva-forms acting as world-lords.
uncertainties: The exact mapping of each lord to each world is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Sharva, Rudra, Bhima, Bhava, Ugra, Mahan, and Ishana are the seven lords of the worlds, forms of Shiva presiding from the earth world upward.
